2026-08-23.patch_summary: This patch series improves the coverage of selftests/mm by adding new cases to test the khugepaged mechanism, which collapses huge pages into smaller ones. The existing tests were limited and did not cover all possible scenarios. The new additions include folio-order helpers, anon collapse cases with mixed sources, a shared-source write race, and tests for various edge cases such as faults, MADV_DONTNEED, pins, fork, mremap, reclaim, compaction, and KASAN/lockdep checks. The changes also address existing issues in the test suite, including scaling the collapse wait time with PMD size, skipping certain cases where they are not applicable, and retrying swap cases to ensure accurate results.
